regions.full_page: Pneumonia Cured Baby Patricia Turner (18 months) enrolled for two yrs Jan. 30th 4:45 p.m. for pneumonia. Little hope entertained by doctors for recovery. At 5: p.m. she was playing around the cradle when her uncle got home who had enrolled her. Febr. 1st 10 p.m. Mother reports in tears Baby worse again and enrolls her again for year promising perpetual enrollment if baby is better when she and the father (non-Cath) get home Baby found asleep rests all night - promise again not kept - she grows worse and is reported so at about 10 a.m. Feb. 2nd by phone. "No wonder, " answered Fr. S., "If you people would keep your promises you would have a different story." The Catholic grandfather comes and enrolles her at 1:30 p.m.

regions.full_page: Children after Baronnes. Mrs. Marie Bradley and husband lamenting nine years that God had not blest them with children. Her mother enrolled her that a second operation might be successful if must be Mother reports To-day no further operation necessary A beautiful boy of 18 months now fills home with music - expecting a sister or an- other brother.

regions.full_page: Rosellio Couple lost five little children. 6th Child 4 was going the same way - cold up above waste from feet up - hope of life near- ly gone neighbor who is god-father of child called over the phone to enroll him and immediately improvement was noticed. God-father - Henry J. Wargnier - Boy perfect. 3053 Townsend

regions.full_page: Joann Gietzen 15 month old seemed paralysed, had never tried to stand or to use her legs. Enrolled for one year with promise of Father to enroll her perpetually as soon as improvement were noticed - and weekly instead of monthly Communion for 1 year one minute after she stood alone on mothers lap. ... next day started to walk.

regions.full_page: Sight saved Irene Carpenter (11809 Corbett) very anxious about con- dition of eye caused by poisonous insect flying into it July 4th. She enrolled in S.M. A. day before yesterday and in excitement forgot eye-drops just received from oculist slept well that night and comes this A.M. OK. Will keep neat bottle of eye drops for remem- brance.
